proposal: A single machine-readable admission result per task, schema autoloop.task-admission/v1 (see ta1-admission-schema.json), produced by a deterministic classifier BEFORE Graph execution, consumed by the scheduler, sub-agent envelope builder, writer/reviewer enforcement, durable layer, review bundle and telemetry.

requirements.deterministic: same task inputs + same classifier_version -> same size/risk/profile/admission_id (pure functions, canonical JSON input digest). Re-classification on resume must reproduce the identical admission_id or HOLD (drift guard).
requirements.explainable: reasons array required; size_details.dimensions carry per-dimension reasons; risk_details.signals carry triggered + reason; escalation_log records every fail-closed escalation. Every decision traceable to input evidence.
requirements.fail_closed: unknown capability id -> denied; malformed admission -> HOLD; missing evidence -> under_classified -> escalate, never default-allow; runtime cannot invent capability grants.
requirements.machine_verifiable: validates against the JSON schema; admission_id = sha256(canonical(payload-without-admission_id)); capability grants must be a subset of the capability registry; profile must match the (size, risk) matrix cell; subset_of_lifecycle_authorization enforced against the authority record digest.
requirements.versioned: classifier_version constant '1.0.0' in v1; schema_version int; every admission record pins both.
backward_compatible_strategy: additive-only field evolution: new optional fields; required set never grows for old consumers
extensions object is the sanctioned growth point; extensions never grant capability
new enum values require classifier_version bump; consumers must fail-closed on unknown enum values (never coerce)
old admission records remain valid under their schema_version; a new classifier may re-classify only with explicit re-admission (never silently at resume)

lifecycle.produce: at task intake, after parent-card binding, BEFORE decomposition
lifecycle.bounded_refinement: allowed exactly once, after preliminary read-only discovery and before any mutation; refinement must preserve risk monotonicity
lifecycle.freeze: bound into the durable checkpoint fingerprint; resume compares admission_id — mismatch -> HOLD / ADMISSION_DRIFT

consume.scheduler: node role grants + repair budget + durability flags
consume.subagent_envelope: toolPermissions + mutationScope filled FROM admission (never guessed)
consume.reviewer: review strength + strict routing from admission
consume.durable_layer: durability + checkpoint policy + frozen admission digest
consume.review_bundle: admission decision recorded in the bundle (evidence + explainability)
consume.telemetry: admission quality metrics: overkill (heavy profile on trivial outcome) / under-classification (fast path that later failed) / escalation frequency

lifecycle.authority: admission is a DERIVED decision: it can only narrow the lifecycle authority record (parent ∩ child ∩ runtime). A conflict between admission result and authority record -> HOLD / AUTHORITY_CONFLICT. The admission runtime itself is subject to governance (RS.SELF_MODIFICATION) and may not be modified by the tasks it admits.

sample.note: full sample records live in ta1-sample-admissions.json and are machine-validated by scripts/ta1-verify.mjs against this schema
